Generated blueprints typically only require 1-10% of their max electricity consumptions.
GIFtorio supports up to 8k resolution at 60 fps, with nearly infinite video lengths!
For lower filesize, try setting 'Compression' to 'Delta'. This is lossless, but prevents seeking.
Create your own signal presets! GIFtorio can use signals provided by external mods using signal presets.
Backwards-compatible with almost all versions of Factorio using signal presets!
For smoother displays, try setting 'Wire Direction' to 'Horizontal' and 'Rotation' to '270° Clockwise'!
Tired of seeing gaps between the combinators and lamps? Try setting 'Margin Y' to '0'!
Using less 'Columns' can help reduce the blueprint filesize! Comes at the cost of increased combinators. Setting 'Columns' to '0' uses as many columns as possible.
Substations can only be of the quality the current signal preset supports.
The Thumbnail Resize Filter is the most optimized and CPU efficient filter!
Setting Signal Sorting to 'Auto' can greatly help reduce the blueprint filesize!
GIFtorio supports both images and videos! Supports any image the browser can load.
GIFtorio will automatically use the most comapct combinator layout to save tilespace!
For faster generation, try setting 'Output Format' to 'Blueprint'.
